name: Shiqi Liu
content: I am a third-year Ph.D. candidate at [Safe AI Lab](https://safeai-lab.github.io/) at Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) advised by Prof. [Ding Zhao](https://www.meche.engineering.cmu.edu/directory/bios/zhao-ding.html). Previously, I earned a master's degree in Mechanical Engineering from CMU. My goal is to build robots that keep learning after they leave the lab. I want them to bring what they already know into new places and refine their skills through experience as the world around them changes.
